first_failure_what: Step 17 inserted _MarketDataRequest into fix_clients.py building FIX repeating groups with flat setField calls instead of the quickfix repeating-group API: two MDEntryType(269) setFields (second overwrites the first, no Group(267,269)/addGroup) and NoRelatedSym(1)+RelatedSymbol flat fields (no Group(146,55)/addGroup, symbol lands on tag 1649). Hidden tests read groups via message.getGroup, so every message-content test dies with FieldNotFound 267/146. Step 14's sandbox prototype already used setField; step 17 committed it to the repo.
model_tried: Explored fix_clients.py/child_clients.py, probed quickfix constants for tags 262-267, then added a _MarketDataRequest template plus subscribe_to_data (263=1) / unsubscribe_to_data (263=2) on BaseFixClient sending via QUOTE_SESS. Self-verified with mock-session scripts that parsed the raw toString instead of getGroup, so the flat-field message looked correct and the group-encoding bug went unnoticed.
notes: Completion was claimed 17 times (steps 30-68) but never confirmed: the harness asked for task_complete:true and the model kept answering with bash echo instead, ending in a 33-call claim/echo cycle until the budget died. Self-checks masked the bug: steps 24-27 parsed raw toString output rather than getGroup(267)/getGroup(146) the way the hidden tests do. 6/13 tests still passed (4 ValueError, method-exposure, cross-client ID non-emptiness), so routing, ID generation and validation were right; only group encoding was wrong. Minor: step 5 git log failed ('not a git repository' in container); every bash step carried parser warnings about missing duration/newline; step 22 fixed int(Field) defaults via .getValue().
